recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-23060 unless a future release-cycle policy changes which comparison targets should appear in the footer.
issue_request: FHIR-23060 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction asking the Current Build bottom menu to offer "Compare to R4" rather than "Compare to R3" after R4 became the current release.
initial_application: The Jira snapshot includes a comment that the change already looked fixed. Git history confirms commit 9baff334d6331ff8d69a1c3ae2fcab27e1572811 changed source/newfooter.html on 2019-08-08 from a Compare to R3/STU3 link to a Compare to R4/R4 link; commit 24e6675dcd8f9f6dbd68745fbcfcafc9b32443b2 later moved that footer template to tools/templates/newfooter.html.
additional_context: The originating Zulip thread records Peter Jordan proposing the change, Grahame Grieve agreeing, and Peter filing GForge #23060. FHIR-I minutes on 2019-11-04 list GF 23060 as a typo that was auto-approved. Later footer work now exposes Compare to R4, Compare to R5, and Compare to Last Ballot links for the current release cycle. Related comparison-link audits FHIR-34058 and FHIR-41288 are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because tools/templates/newfooter.html already has Compare to R4 and no Compare to R3 link, and the diff pages that include the footer remain part of the current source hierarchy.

related_jiras.note: Later Published/Persuasive issue about stale R3 comparison behavior; already has an Issue-Reconcile-Key commit on the combined branch.
Later Applied/Persuasive issue about hosted comparison links; already has an Issue-Reconcile-Key commit on the combined branch.
